name: oficina-live
description: Oficina virtual en pixel art con presencia en tiempo real e integración con Teams

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c red,blue "npm run dev -w @ol/server" "npm run dev -w @ol/web"
scripts.demo: concurrently -k -n api,web -c red,blue "npm run demo -w @ol/server" "npm run dev -w @ol/web"
scripts.demo:lan: concurrently -k -n api,web -c red,blue "npm run demo -w @ol/server" "npm run dev:lan -w @ol/web"
scripts.demo:b: OL_WEB_PUERTO=5290 OL_API=http://127.0.0.1:8890 OL_URL_PUBLICA=http://localhost:5290 OL_ORIGENES=http://localhost:5290,http://127.0.0.1:5290 concurrently -k -n api,web -c red,blue "OL_PUERTO=8890 OL_DATA=$PWD/data-demo-b npm run demo -w @ol/server" "npm run dev -w @ol/web"
scripts.demo:c: OL_WEB_PUERTO=5390 OL_API=http://127.0.0.1:8990 OL_URL_PUBLICA=http://localhost:5390 OL_ORIGENES=http://localhost:5390,http://127.0.0.1:5390 concurrently -k -n api,web -c red,blue "OL_PUERTO=8990 OL_DATA=$PWD/data-demo-c npm run demo -w @ol/server" "npm run dev -w @ol/web"
scripts.local: OL_URL_PUBLICA=http://localhost:5190 concurrently -k -n api,web -c red,blue "npm run local -w @ol/server" "npm run dev -w @ol/web"
scripts.test: npm run test -w @ol/shared && npm run test -w @ol/server && npm run test -w @ol/web && npm run test -w @ol/arte
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @ol/shared && npm run typecheck -w @ol/server && npm run typecheck -w @ol/web && npm run typecheck -w @ol/arte
